context: A career coach and a student discuss college choices
purpose: Teach: 業種/勤め/往復/公立/進学/件数/位置づけ/合同

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日はわざわざ往復で二時間もかけて相談に来てくれてありがとう。
lines.en: Thank you for traveling two hours round-trip just to come consult with me today.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, slow pace, motherly teacher tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いえ、進路のことで本当に悩んでいて、先生にぜひお話を伺っておきたかったんです。
lines.en: No, I'm really troubled about my path, and I wanted to hear your advice.
lines.style: Earnest student voice, polite humble keigo, slightly anxious

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。まず大学進学について、君の中での位置づけを教えてくれる?
lines.en: I see. First, can you tell me how university ranks among your priorities?
lines.style: Calm probing question, gentle teacher cadence, inviting tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直、親が会社勤めの普通のサラリーマンなので、安定した業種に就きたい気持ちが強いです。
lines.en: Honestly, since my dad's a regular salaried worker, I want a stable industry.
lines.style: Honest self-disclosure, slight hesitation, thoughtful pace

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 去年の卒業生の相談件数を見ても、私立より公立を選ぶ子が増えているのよ。
lines.en: Even looking at last year's consultation counts, more students chose public over private.
lines.style: Informative mentor tone, citing data calmly, measured delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学費のことを考えると、僕も公立で良いかなと思い始めています。
lines.en: Thinking about tuition costs, I'm starting to think public would be fine too.
lines.style: Reflective realization, softer voice, agreeable nod tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それと、来月うちの高校と隣校で合同の進路説明会があるから、ぜひ参加してね。
lines.en: Also, next month our school and the neighboring one host a joint career fair.
lines.style: Helpful suggestion, slightly upbeat, encouraging invitation

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。今日伺った話を整理して、もう一度家族と相談してみます。
lines.en: Thank you. I'll organize what you told me today and discuss it again with family.
lines.style: Grateful closing, resolved tone, polite formal student speech
